### “Chariots of Grace” All Around Us
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/chariots-of-grace-all-around-us/
Passage: 2 Kings 6:16-17
Points:
- Believers often feel like Elisha’s servant when life pressures seem to surround and overwhelm them.
- We must pray for God to open our eyes to His sovereign rule and unseen presence.
- Seasons of vulnerability and human limitations invite us to stop striving and rely entirely on God.
- Recognizing that Jesus is greater than worldly troubles empowers us to show grace to others.

### Praying for Open Eyes
Author: Brent Rinehart
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-may-25.html
Passage: 2 Kings 6:17
Points:
- Focusing only on immediate hardships can blind us to the larger picture of what God is doing.
- The Lord remains at work in our circumstances even when His hand cannot be physically observed.
- Believers can ask God to grant spiritual vision both for themselves and for others facing trials.
- Faith trusts God’s goodness without needing to physically see angelic chariots of fire.

### Closer Than We Think
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/closer-than-we-think-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-january-18-2016.html
Passage: 2 Kings 6:17
Points:
- The spiritual realm and heavenly reality exist right alongside our physical world.
- God works through both natural and supernatural means to accomplish His divine purposes.
- Elisha addressed his servant's panic by praying for the veil of the spiritual world to be lifted.
- Believers facing daunting problems can take heart knowing God's unseen forces defend His people.

### Open Our Eyes, Lord
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-march-16.html
Passage: 2 Kings 6:17
Points:
- Fixating only on visible obstacles leads to fear, distress, and worldly coping tactics.
- Elisha remained peaceful because he recognized spiritual reality rather than mere physical odds.
- Believers can pray for spiritual sight to perceive how God stands with them in difficulties.
- Reminding one another of God's greater power builds courage in the face of intimidating situations.
